purpose: One status-word family across the browser and the host. Every case is a terminal-or-not task record read by log_events.js (taskDoneIsTerminal + taskTerminalPhase + taskPresentation) and by ouroboros.project_dialogue (outcome_phase + OUTCOME_PHASE_HEADLINE + _completion_verdict). Every typed cause with an owner sentence carries a case here, so the two TASK_CAUSE_PHRASES twins cannot drift apart unnoticed. A new axis, reason or acceptance status is added to both sides in the same commit, with a row here.
